description: Write tests that pass on correct code and fail on plausible bugs.

inputs.name: objective
inputs.description: What the task must achieve, from the task record.

inputs.name: acceptanceCriteria
inputs.description: Conditions the result is checked against.

outputs.name: tests
outputs.description: Test files that exercise each promised behavior.

steps.description: List the behaviors the code promises from its source and the task, including edge cases and error paths.
steps.evidence: A behavior list with path:line citations.

steps.description: Write tests that each check one behavior with concrete expected values. A test must fail if that behavior breaks.
steps.evidence: A file.apply_patch receipt for the test file.

steps.description: Run the tests against the current code; they must pass.
For each behavior, ask which simple bug the tests would miss, and add a case that catches it.
steps.evidence: The list of bugs considered and the case that catches each.
